The DH at the University of Bern maintains and supports Linked Open Data Services. WissKI is a collaborative information system that allows researchers to structure, link, and analyze data. Its innovative visualization tools promote the sharing and dissemination of research data.

We host, maintain, and advise on all things LOD.

## Services

-   Advice and support on using WissKI and Logre
-   Provision of tools for semantic data modeling
-   support with publishing and analyzing research data

## Pilots

### LESSH – Linked Elites: ORD for the SSH

LESSH transforms the Swiss Elites database of the Swiss Elite Observatory (OBELIS, University of Lausanne) into a Linked Open Data knowledge graph, modelled with CIDOC CRM and the SDHSS ontologies and hosted in a WissKI-based LOD4HSS environment. The public interface [Linked Elites Suisses](https://elites-suisses.lod4hss.org/) queries the graph live through its SPARQL endpoint, documents the step [from tables to Linked Open Data](https://elites-suisses.lod4hss.org/documentation/table-to-lod.html), and offers natural-language access via *Swiss Elites Chat* (login required). LESSH is a cooperation with OBELIS (UNIL), the College of Humanities (EPFL) and the Data Science Lab (University of Bern).
